answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Proof of unique aurora sighting log with magnetometer data. It requires sightings paired with magnetometer readings from one backyard observatory, so the tide of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the cipher first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The reef is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
